differs from its siblings except the transcribed selections. So: hover and press are INFERRED.
HOVER = one rung up: an outlined control takes the store card 2 wash (bright ink at .22 over
its rest fill) and its stroke, spine and ink go bright; a filled control lifts to #f63333.
PRESS = the held red #a52223 with the dark ink on every class (the Login bar's fill, the
darker of the era's two filled reds). Geometry never changes: growth and inversion are selection.

DASHBOARD uses a separate 12-row composite mesh; see dashboard-fidelity.md.
1 . Cells cut the BOTTOM-LEFT corner (badge 15/57, nav 16/62, list row 12/68);
cards cut the TOP-RIGHT (51 login, 13 store); buttons cut the BOTTOM-RIGHT (9).
2 . Selected controls invert; dashboard T2 keeps bright text on a stronger badge field.
3 . A card or panel that matters carries a bright parallelogram bar on its right
edge with cut ends, and the edge steps 8 to 12 inward below the bar's foot.
4 . A stack of cells hangs a 3px spine off its left edge, stopping at the knee.
5 . Tab rows are the one square-cornered shape and are plainer than the row above.
6 . Micro-text everywhere: a four-line CC35 notice, rotated maker marks in corners
and margins, code tapes with barcode ticks, numbered margin chips (1 left, 2 right).
7 . The store screen has no header row at all; its logotype block replaces it.
8 . No white anywhere: the traces sample none, and dashboard tape/chip faces reach #fb3535.
Corner::Chamfer { cut: 15.0 } is one value on one corner; the traces measure 8, 9, 12, 13,
15, 16, 22, 24, 42, 51, and which corner is cut depends on the widget class.
fg RED_FILL #de2e2e is darker than every trace bright ink; dim RED_MID #a32226 and border
RED_DEEP #5e1112 likewise . tape OFF_WHITE #dedede: the traces sample no white at all.
panel and bloom GLOW #001a33 against the measured #14244e..#19274e and the band #2a3a51 to #101f3d.
Ground::Flat is deliberate (mailbox.rs calls the glow photo residue) but all four traces draw it.
Layout::OpsCharts says img-07 is a chart screen; dashboard-trace.svg (G1i 94%) says six-diamond hub.
NOT AT FULL EXTENT ON THIS SHEET: the message panel (top-right corner only;
full box 721x387), the scroll rail (210 of 565), the list (3 rows of 8), the nav
(2 rows of 5), the menu (1 diamond of 6). Store card 4, a card cut by the photo
frame at x 1557 with no chamfer and no edge bar, is photo residue and is not drawn.
